_comment: Pterodactyl Panel Egg Configuration for MotorStorm Status Bots
name: MotorStorm Status Bots
author: ZoniBoy00@pm.me
description: Discord status bots for MotorStorm servers (AE, Apoc, PR, MV) with multi-channel support and lobby notifications

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "Skipping installation - user uploaded files"
    exit 0
fi

if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "Updating git repository..."
        git pull
    else
        echo "Cloning repository: ${GIT_REPO}"
        if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
            git clone --single-branch --branch ${GIT_REPO} .
        else
            git clone ${GIT_REPO} .
        fi
    fi
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo "Installing npm dependencies..."
    npm ci
    echo "Building TypeScript..."
    npm run build
    echo "Installation complete!"
else
    echo "Error: package.json not found!"
    exit 1
fi
